body:
Design the loading state of the My Accounts screen for **mifos-x-open-banking**, a Open Banking KMP super-app serving consumer retail banking and field officer agent banking powered by Open Bank Project API v7, built with Compose Multiplatform across Android, iOS, Desktop, and Web.

Palette: background #12140E, surface #12140E, onSurface #E3E3D8, primary #B2D188, onPrimary #1F3701, primaryContainer #354E16, secondary #A0CFCB, surfaceContainer #1E201A, surfaceContainerHigh #282A24, outline #8F9285, outlineVariant #44483D, accent #4C662B.

**Component 1 — Top App Bar Shimmer** (56dp tall, full width, background #12140E): Shimmer rectangle 120dp wide x 22dp tall, left-aligned 16dp from edge, representing the "My Accounts" title. Alongside it, a 24dp x 24dp circular shimmer on the right edge 16dp inset representing the help icon. Shimmer base #1E201A, highlight sweep #282A24, animation 1200ms horizontal left-to-right. skeleton_screen archetype.

**Component 2 — Search Bar Shimmer** (52dp tall, full width minus 32dp insets, top margin 12dp, corner radius 12dp): Single rounded-rectangle shimmer block spanning the full search field width. Shimmer base #1E201A, highlight #282A24, same 1200ms cadence. No chip row, no filter tabs — this is purely a search field placeholder.

**Component 3 — Bank Group 1 Header Shimmer** (36dp tall, full width minus 32dp insets, top margin 20dp): Horizontal row with a 20dp x 20dp square shimmer (bank icon placeholder) on the left, then two stacked shimmers on its right — 140dp x 14dp (bank name) above and 80dp x 12dp (account count) below, 4dp gap between them. On the far right a 64dp x 14dp shimmer represents the group subtotal. Shimmer base #1E201A, highlight #282A24.

**Component 4 — Account Card Shimmer 1** (88dp tall, full width minus 32dp insets, top margin 8dp, corner radius 12dp, background #1E201A): Inside the Card, top row has a 160dp x 16dp shimmer (account label) left and a 72dp x 20dp pill shimmer (type badge) right with 8dp gap. Middle row has a 100dp x 22dp shimmer representing the balance amount, top margin 10dp. Bottom row has a 16dp x 16dp square shimmer (IBAN icon) plus a 180dp x 12dp shimmer (IBAN number), 6dp gap, top margin 8dp.

**Component 5 — Account Card Shimmer 2** (88dp tall, same Card layout as Component 4, top margin 8dp): Mirrors Component 4 structure exactly for the second account row. All shimmer dimensions identical. Shimmer base #282A24, highlight #44483D for subtle visual separation.

**Component 6 — Bank Group 2 Header Shimmer** (36dp tall, full width minus 32dp insets, top margin 20dp): Identical structure to Component 3 — icon shimmer left, name + count shimmers center, subtotal shimmer right. Same 1200ms sweep.

**Component 7 — Account Card Shimmer 3** (88dp tall, same Card layout as Component 4, top margin 8dp): Single card shimmer for the business account row. Same dimensions and shimmer tokens as Component 4.

**Component 8 — Divider Shimmer** (1dp tall, full width minus 32dp insets, top margin 16dp): Thin horizontal shimmer bar, color #44483D, no animation needed — static separator.

**Component 9 — Total Balance Footer Shimmer** (52dp tall, full width minus 32dp insets, top margin 8dp, corner radius 12dp, background #1E201A): Left side 140dp x 14dp shimmer (total label), right side 80dp x 20dp shimmer (total amount). Both horizontally aligned at vertical center with 16dp internal padding.

**Component 10 — FAB Shimmer** (56dp x 56dp, bottom-right corner, 16dp from screen edge, corner radius 16dp): Single square shimmer block with primary container color base #354E16, highlight #4C662B, representing the add account FAB.

DO NOT use em-dash anywhere in text. DO NOT make any headline >3 lines or any subtitle >25 words. DO NOT break the page theme between sections. DO NOT place light text on light buttons or dark text on dark buttons.

Full vertically scrollable layout on #12140E background. All shimmer placeholders pulse between #1E201A and #282A24 at 1200ms cadence — calm, steady rhythm that signals data is on its way without creating visual urgency. The earthy accent #4C662B grounds the FAB in the trustworthy, growth-oriented palette, keeping the loading state composed and professional rather than anxious.
